meta.name: redesign-existing-projects
meta.description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将现有网站和应用的视觉设计提升至高端品质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有设计粗糙的网站或应用，想在不破坏功能的前提下提升视觉品质
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade existing websites and apps to premium visual quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a rough-looking site or app and want to elevate its design without breaking functionality

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先扫描你的项目代码，找出设计上的常见问题（比如字体、颜色、布局），然后在不破坏原有功能的前提下，逐一改进，让界面看起来更专业、更精致。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 升级或重新设计一个已有的网站或应用项目时触发。

say.text: 帮我重新设计这个项目的界面，让它看起来更高级。
say.note: Claude 会开始扫描代码并执行设计审计。

say.text: 检查这个页面的排版和颜色，并给出改进建议。
say.note: Claude 会重点审计排版和颜色部分。

say.text: 优化这个组件的交互状态，添加悬停和点击反馈。
say.note: Claude 会针对交互和状态进行升级。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans your project code, identifies common design issues (typography, colors, layout), and applies targeted upgrades without breaking functionality, making the interface look more polished and professional.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to redesign or upgrade an existing website or app project.

say_en.text: Redesign this project's interface to make it look premium.
say_en.note: Claude will start scanning and auditing the design.

say_en.text: Audit the typography and colors on this page and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on typography and color audit.

say_en.text: Optimize the interactive states of this component, add hover and click feedback.
say_en.note: Claude will upgrade interactivity and states.
